verdict.rationale: Microsoft's own docs describe Teams Export APIs that export 1:1, group chat, meeting chat, and channel messages, which covers private conversations alongside channel history. They also note that user-deleted messages stay retrievable through the export APIs for 21 days. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the output format (e.g., JSON) and of admin policy/permission gating for private chats, a turnkey whole-tenant bulk export rather than API-only access, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
